title: Names and values with accents, Greek, Japanese and an emoji, on a mirrored part
how: The library, the package, the element, the value and the signal all have characters outside ASCII;
the lookups by name (library and package, element and pad) are by exact text, so they still find each other:
2 layers, both copper; 1 package with 2 pads; 1 element, mirrored (MR180), so on the bottom side; its 2 pads are on the signal.
